sender_summary: Vijay Shewale drives growth and distribution for Kasparro, an AI Visibility platform that helps brands get discovered, recommended, and chosen by AI engines — ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, and Google AI Mode. He combines a technical background (React, Flask, Python) with hands-on growth marketing experience, having built organic distribution systems on X and Reddit that generated 1M+ impressions and 18K+ karma through systematic, metrics-first experimentation. He is direct, data-led, and focused on real traction over vanity metrics.
receiver_summary: Akash Sinha is Co-founder & CEO of Cashfree Payments, one of India's leading payment infrastructure companies, founded in 2015 and RBI-authorized (PA-PG, PA-CB, PPI licenses), processing $80B+ in annual transaction volume for 800,000+ businesses. Cashfree does roughly ₹1000 crore in revenue with 50% YoY growth, is EBITDA positive, and is backed by Y Combinator, Apis Partners, KRAFTON, and State Bank of India, incubated by PayPal. Akash is aggressively expanding cross-border payments toward 25% of revenue mix. He has a D/C DISC profile: highly direct and results-driven, confrontational when defending Cashfree's reputation against misinformation ('I am going to say this once, clearly, and on record — it is a lie'), and structures every argument with hard metrics and numbered breakdowns. He is economic buyer — sole decision-maker on strategic spend — and is intensely competitive about market positioning: he tracks who is 'threatened by the numbers' he shares and defends Cashfree's category leadership publicly and often.
outreach_goal: Get Akash to sign up for a free trial of Kasparro's AI Search Visibility platform so Cashfree can see and control how it's discovered, recommended, and compared against competitors (e.g. Razorpay, PayU) by AI engines like ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, and Google AI Mode.
offer: Kasparro is an AI Visibility platform that helps brands get discovered, recommended, and chosen by AI engines — ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Google AI Mode. As merchants and enterprise buyers increasingly ask AI assistants to recommend or compare payment infrastructure providers instead of Googling and comparing manually, Kasparro gives companies like Cashfree visibility into and control over how they're represented, cited, and ranked in AI-generated answers — including against direct competitors. Free trial: https://kasparro.com/
pain_points: As merchants and enterprise buyers increasingly ask AI assistants 'best payment gateway for cross-border/B2B/marketplace payments' before doing traditional search, Cashfree's market leadership (₹1000cr revenue, 800K+ merchants, first-mover RBI licenses) may not be reflected at all in AI-generated recommendations, Akash actively and publicly defends Cashfree's reputation against misinformation in traditional channels, but has zero visibility into whether AI engines are citing accurate, outdated, or competitor-favoring narratives when buyers ask direct comparison questions like 'Cashfree vs Razorpay', Cashfree's aggressive cross-border expansion (targeting 25% of revenue) means entering new geographies where AI-driven vendor discovery may already be shaping enterprise shortlists before Cashfree's brand authority has caught up there
tone: Direct, fast, data-driven, zero fluff — structured arguments with hard metrics, numbered breakdowns, competitive framing. Respect his time and match his pace. No generic founder flattery.
